The table groups of this param: rows with the same ID form one group.
Select a group to show its rows in the Rows window.
Alt+click a group's name to rename it.

Toggle what the search matches.
In row mode, the search uses the same syntax as the Rows window's search and shows the groups that contain a matching row, with the number of matches in the Rows column.

Current Mode:
{0}

The number of rows in the group.
While searching rows: matching rows / rows.
The total chanceWeight of the group's rows. Each row's roll chance is its weight divided by this total.
The weights of this group add up to 0, so none of its rows can be rolled.

This group has no name, so its first row's name is shown.
Alt+click to name the group.

Change the ID of every row in this group, and move its name with it.
Applied when you leave the field (Escape cancels). Refused if another group already uses the ID.
ID {0} is already used by a table group. The next free ID is {1}.
The ID of the new group. Defaults to the next free ID after this group.
Already used. The next free ID is {0}.
Add a table group with one row, using the field defaults.
Duplicate cancelled: ID {0} is already used by a table group. An offset of {1} would be free.
Delete this table group and the rows it contains.

The ID offset of each copy: copy N gets the group ID + N x offset.

Shared with the row Duplicate setting (Rows window and toolbar), so changing it here also changes it there.

How many copies of the group to make.

Shared with the row Duplicate setting (Rows window and toolbar), so changing it here also changes it there.
When enabled, duplicating allows ID collisions. A colliding duplicate adds the source rows to the existing group with the new ID.
Duplicate this table group and the rows it contains.
Duplicate cancelled: it would have added rows to an existing table group.
